name: Google News RSS
license_note: Google News search feed: headlines, publisher and date only; article redirect links are cited, never fetched. Google does not document the feed; the feed text limits it to personal, non-commercial feed-reader use, which is how an octos agent acting for one person uses it. news.google.com/robots.txt disallows /rss; it is honoured when the operator sets OCTOS_RESPECT_ROBOTS=1.
